item.title: security: Agents are your newest insiders. Security must move at their speed.
item.description:
Microsoft announced new capabilities in Microsoft 365 E7 and Project Perception aimed at helping organizations contain AI agent risk and continuously adapt protection. The post frames agents as insider-like risks and focuses on security controls that keep pace with their behavior.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
